news.title: Oil Shipping Costs Spike, Lifting Prices from Pump to Grocery
news.summary: When the oil supertanker Esteem Explorer sails from the United States to Japan in late November, loaded with about 2 million barrels of crude, the journey will cost $81 million. The same journey would have cost $9.1 million last year, on average.
